qs.q: : Platelet Activating Factor (PAF) is chemically classified as a
qs.e: PAF is chemically acetyl-glyceryl-ether-phosphocholine, making it a phospholipid derivative. Despite its small size compared to eicosanoids, it has potent biological activities including platelet aggregation, inflammation, and increased vascular permeability at very low concentrations (nanomolar range).
